CBSE Board Class 12th Re-Evaluation / Verification Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Details : Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the Re-Evaluation / Verification Result of the Class 12th (Higher Secondary) Examination 2026. The board examinations were conducted from 03 March 2026 to 10 April 2026. After completing the evaluation process, the board has officially released the CBSE Board 12th Result 2026. Students who appeared in the board examinations can now check their results which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Class 12th (XIIth) Annual Exam Date : 03 March 2026 to 10 April 2026
  • Result Available : 13 May 2026
  • Re-Evaluation/ Verification Result : 21 June 2026

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
